nodes.summary: Let $X$ and $T$ be topological spaces, $P$ a set, $U = (U_\alpha)_{\alpha \in \iota}$ a family of subsets of $X$ and $k$ a natural number. A family of maps $f : P \times X \to T$ is adapted to $U$ with bound $k$ when there is a finite set $A$ of at most $k$ indices such that $f$ is supported on $\bigcup_{\alpha \in A} U_\alpha$.
nodes.title: Adapted families of maps

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a compact metric space, $T$ a metric space, $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^k$ a convex linear polyhedron, $(U_\alpha)_{\alpha \in \iota}$ a family of open subsets of $X$, and $\rho$ a partition of unity on $X$ indexed by $\iota$ and subordinate to $U$. Let $f : P \times X \to T$ be continuous and suppose that for each $p \in P$ the map $x \mapsto f(p, x)$ is a homeomorphism $h_p : X \to T$, and that for some…
nodes.title: Morrison–Walker lemma on adapting families of maps, bi-Lipschitz case

nodes.summary: Let $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^k$ and let $D \subseteq \mathbb{R}^k$ be a finite set (typically the vertex set of a face of a subdivision of $P$). The closed cell of $D$ in $P$ is the set of points of $P$ that lie in the convex hull of $D$, viewed as a subset of $P$.
nodes.title: Closed cells

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a compact topological space, $T$ a topological space, $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^k$ a convex linear polyhedron, $(U_\alpha)_{\alpha \in \iota}$ a family of open subsets of $X$, and $\rho$ a partition of unity on $X$ indexed by $\iota$ and subordinate to $U$ (the closed support of $\rho_\alpha$ lies in $U_\alpha$). Then for every continuous map $f : P \times X \to T$ there is a continuous map…
nodes.title: Morrison–Walker lemma on adapting families of maps to an open cover

nodes.summary: Let $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^k$. A subset $Q \subseteq P$ is a boundary subpolyhedron of $P$ when $Q$ is the convex hull of a finite set of points of $\mathbb{R}^k$, $Q$ lies in the intrinsic frontier (relative boundary) of $P$, and $Q$ is a face of $P$: whenever a point of $Q$ lies in the open segment between two points of $P$, both of those points lie in $Q$.
nodes.title: Boundary subpolyhedra

nodes.summary: A subset $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^k$ is a convex linear polyhedron when it is the convex hull of a finite set of points (equivalently, a bounded intersection of finitely many closed half-spaces).
nodes.title: Convex linear polyhedra

nodes.summary: A polyhedral subdivision of a set $P \subseteq \mathbb{R}^k$ is a geometric simplicial complex in $\mathbb{R}^k$ with finitely many faces whose underlying space equals $P$.
nodes.title: Polyhedral subdivisions

nodes.summary: Let $X$ and $T$ be topological spaces and $P$ a set. A family of maps $f : P \times X \to T$ is supported on a set $S \subseteq X$ when it does not depend on the parameter outside $S$: $f(p, x) = f(p', x)$ for all $p, p' \in P$ and all $x \notin S$.
nodes.title: Families of maps supported on a set

can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
